verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, not a software product with an operable interface, so operating it via natural-language commands is a category error. The boilerplate about 'legal tech, digital workflows and AI-based systems' and the software-supported YSolutions unit do not show any client-facing natural-language command interface, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
